title: Gear Vortex
summary: Two spirals of brass-coloured gears surround an orange-backed open core. This digital prototype has incomplete geometry and motion verification and has not been physically tested.
limitations: Final integrated verification is UNVERIFIED: formal motion and 45 final geometry inspection requests remain incomplete after the shared inspection allowance was exhausted. Earlier scoped standalone measurements are retained, not promoted to an integrated pass.
Formal motion remains UNVERIFIED: current round 4 returned exit 3 with no condition results.

All 238 discrete fixed-center contact samples passed. The 48-state animation and independent visual review passed for modeled form and presented action. Continuous contact, complete coupled motion, retention and physical operation remain unverified.
Seven gears per arm use the fewer/larger fallback; module 1.5 meets the minimum but not the 2.0 preference.
Completed digital geometry, dimensional and delivery checks do not establish physical print readiness.
Physical printing, fit, friction, coasting, balance and durability remain untested.
Orange appearance depends on ambient light and suitable translucent material; rendering colours do not establish physical finishes.
Geometry inspection is incomplete. This prototype is unverified and is not print-ready; see GEOMETRY-NOTES.md.
